recentItems.title: The rap x hardcore crossover is becoming a necessity
Becky G Explains Her Decision That Changed Everything
recentItems.description:
During the latest episode of Visionaries Moments, Becky G talks about the decision to sing an all spanish song and how "Sola" changed the course of her career. She also spoke about how collaborations with Bad Bunny, Peso Pluma and more helped confirm her decision as the right one. Becky G's new album Baraja Bendita is the most authentic version of who she is artistically yet. Becky makes it clear that following your intuition will always lead you down the right path.
